settings.title: Drip Coffee
settings.description: Ground coffee, hot water, a full carafe — drip machines are the reliable backbone of any kitchen. Set it, walk away, and pour cup after cup. Best when you value simplicity and volume over barista theatrics.
settings.best_for: Households that drink coffee by the pot and want fuss-free mornings.

settings.title: Capsule / Single-Serve
settings.description: Drop in a pod, press a button, done — no grinding, no measuring, no cleanup. You trade a little flavor range for unbeatable speed and consistency, every single time.
settings.best_for: Solo drinkers, busy mornings, and homes where everyone wants something different.

settings.title: Espresso
settings.description: Pressurized brewing pulls rich, concentrated shots — the foundation for lattes, cappuccinos, and flat whites at home. There's a small learning curve, but the payoff is genuine coffee-shop quality.
settings.best_for: Latte lovers and aspiring home baristas willing to dial it in.
